slides.title: Module 1 decides your Module 2
slides.body: Each section runs in two modules, and your Module 1 performance decides whether you see the easier or the harder second module. Two students in the same room are not taking the same test — by design.

slides.title: The hard module is the high-score module
slides.body: Top scores are only reachable through the harder Module 2 — the easier one caps your ceiling no matter how perfectly you play it. So when the second module stings, you're not failing. You're in the room where the 1400s live.
slides.tip: Panic is the real trap here

slides.title: Play Module 1 for accuracy
slides.body: Module 1 buys your ceiling, so clean accuracy there matters more than speed. Bank time on the questions you know cold, spend it on the last five, and treat every careless Module 1 miss as the expensive kind — because it is.
